answer: Escrow every payment until a juror grades the work. Each claim the panel cannot verify cuts the payout by a fixed percentage. Release in two stages, half at grade and half after twenty epochs. A farm now has to fund a thousand submissions before any coin moves, and the canyon between submit and settle eats that capital while the operator waits. The velvet pitch of instant rewards collapses into a bill the attacker pays first, with no onyx trophy at the end of it.
